MESSAGE: Hi, I'm Scratch Cat.
Today I'd like to talk to you about the environment and what you can do to help.
Water.
You can find it everywhere
71% of the Earth is covered in the stuff
But only 3% of our water is freshwater
That means, only 3% is useable
And two-thirds of that is locked up in icecaps and glaciers
Water is a resource and water scarcity is a serious problem that has already impacted several countries
These aren't actions that the average person has any control over
But the average person still uses so much water every day
Think for just a minute about all the ways we use water
We clean ourselves in the bath or shower
we drink it.
We wash our dishes
We water our plants and clean our cars
and clean our clothes
We use water in so many ways
The biggest way humans impact the water cycle is with big actions
Like urbanization and deforestation
But there are some simple things you can do to help
The easiest are to watch your water
Take shorter showers. Always keep them under ten minutes.
And turn off the faucet when you are brushing your teeth
But there are some other things you can do too
One tip experts recommend is putting a water bottle in your toilet
If you have an older toilet, you can fill up an old water bottle
and place it in the water tank on the back of your toilet
Your toilet will then use less water each flush!
This next one is probably my favorite tip of all
Avoid hand washing dishes
Whenever possible, use the dishwasher
It takes 5 times more water to hand wash than it does to run an efficient dishwasher
Please
Do you part to make sure water is being used efficiently
It might seem like there is a lot of it out there
But it's all we have
